title: Combustible gas indicator.
officialText:
Combustible gas indicators shall be listed and shall be calibrated in accordance with the
manufacturer’s instructions. Combustible gas indicators shall numerically display a volume scale from zero percent to 100
percent in 1 percent or smaller increments.
